the house is one of the most beautiful and cleanest ive ever been also the communication is great host is very flexible the accepted me with a short notice great experience

highly recommended the apartment was clean and has a modern yet cozy atmosphere to it location is convenient in a rather quiet street thats not far from everything communication with alkis was good he responded almost instantly to our questions

comfortable with a great location i would definitely go there again

stelioss place was great the apartment is very cosy simple and elegant and we especially enjoyed the small terrace it has a greek charm to it and the atmosphere was unique being inside the buildings the apartment is cool and pleasant to hang out in as well as quiet the location is also very good there are things to see in walking distance fe the national archaeology museum or with public transport metro buses trams good connection with the airport with the railway only for people under yo at the central station larissa stelios is also a wonderful host helping us with every detail we needed as well as giving us suggestions on where to go and how to spend our days in athens great place to stay

amazing apartment best location in plaka and the warmest welcome you can imagine in greece everything looks like on the pictures and the view of the rooftop balcony is breathtaking sakis and spyros also provided us with some great tips of where to go out we will definitely come back

our stay was amazing the apartment is gorgeous and conveniently located we walked everywhere we wanted to go in athens its around mins to get to the acropolis a little less to most other things taxisuber are inexpensive if youd rather do that but after all the delicious greek food youll probably want the exercise anyway there are numerous food places very close to the apartment including a dangerously delicious bakery around the corner thanos was an amazing host our flight to athens got in late and we didnt get to the apartment til around am but he was there to greet us and made check in such a pleasant experience he even had a couple of beers and a few food items in the fridge for us so gracious everything is pretty self explanatory except for the hot water for the shower so ask about that during check in but he also has a book that explains everything youll want to know about the apartment which is awesome he is also very responsive to messages and is happy to give you any advice you need for your stay in athens really couldnt have asked for a better host or a nicer apartment when we return to athens in the future we will definitely look for availability at this apartment before anywhere else

people book this house we couldnt believe the value for the quality of the space and location you wont be disappointed we stayed in four different airbnbs during our time in greece and this was the nicest by far it is clean spacious beautiful and the location cant be beat especially for the price our host provided wine cheese fruitand even allowed us to use the washing machine which was a highlight for us after days of traveling we enjoyed walking around plaka during the day and drinking wine on the private rooftop terrace in the evening our host graciously met us for our midnight arrival and gave us clear directions for taking the train to the airport when we departed just a minute walk to the train station which was an added bonus to the location of the house for us highly recommended

i had a great stay at annas and emmanuels place the apartment is very cute cozy and quite its very centrally located so you can reach all the main attractions within a short time anna and emmanuel are very friendly and enjoyable hosts they could give me some very useful tips about the city and especially its restaurants the communication went smoothly and very fast all in all great apartment highly recommended

dimitrios place is so central the location itself is worth it everything is literally a min walk away theres a little wine bar downstairs where you could get a bottle and enjoy the view from the balcony which is a plus very clean and modern the ac struggled a bit but kept cool most of the time even with greek sun towels linen shampooconditioner and bottled water provided cute little attentions like this makes coming to your airbb after a long travel day a real treat we will def be back to stay at dimitrios

we had a very comfortable stay with eleana the accommodation was in an great location and only short walk to shops restaurants and transport it was also very well furnished and the balcony had great views of athens only issue was in regard to checkin and picking up the keys which were not present at the allocated spot nonetheless the issue was solved relatively quickly with the help of eleana overall we had a great stay and i would recommend the place to my family and friends
great location and thanos was incredibly helpful with local tips

met tonis friend outside the apartment who helped us with our luggage when we reached the apartment it was pleasant and very well furnished with modern amenities we were very happy with the modern furnishing and clean apartment toiletries were provided too everything was simple and easy to use and toni was more than happy to help and explain everything to us we also asked for some recommendations for food and where to go which he gladly provided and explained excellent recommendations for food in general a nice place in a young neighborhood with a drinking hole right outside the apartment which opens till late subway tracks are also right beside the apartment so it is very easily located just follow the sound of the subway

it was a big pleasure to be guest at vasilios place everything was just as described apartment was clean and wellequipped towels hair dryer soap shampoo etc vasilios found answers for all of my million questions he responds very quick for messages i totally recommend this place

higher grounds is simple and sweet being close to public transit and museums you can explore athens very efficiently the rooms are clean the beds are fine the kitchen is good ac works fine there is an additional big fan wifi was flawless for us the host is very nice and always available the descriptions and travel tips here are very good in fact there are some comments about safety in the neighborhood even though it is obviously not an expensive part of town we never felt uncomfortable the bathroom is also mentioned to be small perhaps its not so good for the obese but for us it was fine and kind of cute in fact would stay again

aliki was very easy to communicate and get in touch with she made meeting up at the metro station super easy and convenient she also explained to us which line to take exactly which stop to get off her and her boyfriend walked us to the apartment showed us inside and answered all the questions we had as well as made sure we were comfortable aliki left us with a great map of athens and sent me a wonderful list of things to do and places to eat while we were visiting the apartment was very clean and exactly what was advertised i would definitely recommend staying at alikis place to anyone that is looking for a wonderful host in a cute apartment that is close to the fun bars in gazi and is a short walk from the acropolis and other major sites in athens

we arrived a bit early and as the previous guest left very early stella and nikos allowed our early check in and also a bit of a later check out thanks guys this was very helpful for us communication with this host was extremely easy and fast they are very accomodating and helpful the place is in a great location one of the prettiest neighborhoods in athens we wanted to stay longer we did not need any public transport to the main sights because its all within walking distance walking distance as expected in europe a lot of places to eat nearby we strongly reccommend you go to ergon house which is delicious and the price is similar to all the taberns nearby thar are not too tasty we had a brunch and a dinner there and it was delish the airbnb can be reached by one bus directly from the airport that costs euros one way route x which is also a plus when you travel on a budget very recommended if you take this bus back to the airport be sure to leave with plenty of time because it is always full thanks for everything stella and nikos we will be recommending your place to all our friends and family

the apartment was spacious very clean and comfortable the location was great near two metro stops and there are restaurants bars and a supermarket nearby toni was great at answering any query and checking in was a simple process highly recommended

teos apartment was amazing its location was a minute walk or a minute uber ride to all major archeological and cultural sites in athens it was also within a minute walk of supermarkets and even less for some smaller stores it is located in a typical athenian neighbourhood so be prepared for some noise the space is filled with character and had plenty of space for the two of us the apartment included a stove microwave fridge and had all the utensils necessary for cooking the bathroom was clean and tidy it was a perfect place to set as a base for our athens travels as for teo we couldnt ask for more he both picked us up and dropped us off at the aiport because like us he was a budget traveller and thought nothing of helping us out for much cheaper than a taxi he provided us with maps suggestions and advice and communication between us was always quick and easy we highly recommend staying with teo

great location but nothing special about the management kitchen utensils very dirty to the point that we had to wash everything impersonal management without tips or special advices simply a notebook with a long list of restaurants thanks anyway but something needs to be improved

panos and emmys place was extremely convenient for serum ivf about minutes walk panos was extremely helpful with any questions i had including various travel instructions the apartment was very comfortable and as described a comfy bed and lots of room in the bedroom for storage fully equipped kitchen clean bright bathroom books to read if you wanted and dvds to watch there is only one air conditioning unit in the bedroom but it didnt take long for it to cool down the whole apartment the hot water is heated by an immersion heater which needs to be put on for half an hour before having a shower the apartment felt very secure even though it was on the bottom floor all windows were raised up from ground level and there were heavy duty shutters gates the area itself seemed very safe it was mainly a residential area but close to cafes and restaurants it was a little noisy at some times of day around pm when there was a little more traffic on the road but only if the front windows were open with the windows closed it was pretty quiet all in all a great apartment for the price

dimitris was an amazing host super communicative and helpful he went out of his way to help check us in at am and arranged a cheaper taxi he even let us stay later and check out well after the check out time i personally think the location was convenienttheres a metro super close and its a cheap and convenient way to move around overall a nice place

stelios as very reactiv the appartment looked very nice and spacefull

stevens apartment is such a great place to stay you could reach easily the metro station called larissa station and from there you can reach the important stuff easily the communication with steven was nice and really warm the answers to my questions arrived quickly thank you very much for the nice stay

great location close to restaurants markets and all activities including acropolis and museums very quiet ideal for a couple pantelis who has a shop near the room is very available for every service you may need
